schedule.title: Advanced Periodic Boundary Conditions
schedule.abstract: Exploring modern approaches to simulating particle systems with periodic boundary conditions, including optimizations for GPU computing and strategies for handling long-range interactions efficiently.

talks.title: Numerical Stability in Long-Range Interactions
talks.abstract: Recent advances in maintaining numerical stability for long-range force calculations in large-scale simulations, with practical implementations and benchmarking results.

talks.title: Scaling Simulations to Billions of Particles
talks.abstract: Techniques for efficient parallelization and memory management when simulating massive particle systems. Learn best practices for distributed computing, load balancing, and performance optimization at exascale.

talks.title: Machine Learning for Particle Dynamics Prediction
talks.abstract: Novel approaches using neural networks and deep learning to predict particle behavior and accelerate simulations by several orders of magnitude.

talks.title: Energy Conservation in Molecular Dynamics
talks.abstract: Methods for maintaining energy conservation in MD simulations with adaptive timesteps and symplectic integrators for long-term stability.

schedule.title: Visualization Techniques for Large-Scale Simulations
schedule.abstract: Advanced visualization strategies for understanding particle dynamics in billion-particle systems using GPU rendering and progressive refinement.
